text:
aj: Quick intake — we need a 2-week slice for Optimize toolkit focused on batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Customers are pressing for guidance and a pilot with AcmeHealth.

maria: +1. What are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves for the pilot?

lee: Must-have: CLI/Console surface for per-route batching suggestions + a warnings API for eval alerts. Nice-to-have: automatic quantization recommender with rollback.

sam: Agree. Add acceptance criteria: p99 latency regression <= 5% vs baseline; token cost reduction >= 12% for batchable workloads; alert false positive < 10%.

katie: From onboarding/CS: Acme wants examples for mobile clients and long-context docs. They also want per-tenant guardrails and a simple opt-out switch.

aj: Dependencies: eng-runtime needs KV-prefix caching rollout and a batching policy hook (PR #4312). Eng-ML needs eval thresholds + representative prompt sets. SRE needs a rollback playbook.

lee: Owners: lee -> batching policy DSL, maria -> console surface + docs, sree -> quant recs prototype, aj -> pilot coordination + acceptance gating.

sree: Prototype note: quant recommendations will run offline on sample traces and produce profiles. Minimal JSON output we expect: 
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-open-13b",
  "profile": "q4_0",
  "expected_token_savings_pct": 18
}
```
(we'll also emit a confidence score).

maria: Console mock: per-route card with current config, recommended batch_size, cache_ttl, quant_profile, and a button "Apply to pilot". Add small CTA: "Show impact estimate". Needs UX review.

sam: Monitoring: telemetry events for "recommendation_applied", "eval_alert_triggered" with fields {route, model, metric, delta, tenant}. Build a Grafana dashboard template and alert burn-in job.

katie: Pilot gating: recruit 2 tenants (AcmeHealth + one mid-market) and run for 2 weeks, validate metrics + run eval harness for safety checks and customer feedback.

aj: Proposed short launch criteria: 1) API/UI for recommendations in prod shadow mode; 2) Engine accepts batching hook + prefix cache; 3) Eval alerts firing with FP <10% on verification set; 4) SRE runbook + automated rollback path.

lee: Risk list: tail-latency regressions on single-shot queries if batching misfires; cache poisoning/eviction policy surprises; quantization failures for specific attention kernels.

maria: Next steps: schedule 30m scoping tomorrow 11:00am. Ticket estimates: product ~0.5 FTE for 2 weeks, eng-runtime ~2 sprint-weeks, eng-ml ~1 sprint-week, docs ~0.2 FTE.

aj: tagging for visibility: @product @eng-runtime @eng-ml @sre. Please ack or update owners.

sam: ack

maria: ack

sree: ack (will drop prototype by EOD Fri)

lee: ack

katie: ack (I'll start pilot outreach)
